item.content:encoded:
As I said on IRC: The main issue with this is the Drano torture thing. First off, it's presuming Jack Bauer techniques actually work in real life (they don't), and the Drano thing is… boring. Also as I said on IRC — Honestly, it could've still worked, by not using Drano, but by misdirecting with some horrifically described anomalous thing. It would still be bullshit but /fascinating/ bullshit.

Regardless, +1. Whether or not the premise here is gonna turn out to be bullshit, it certainly forces the reader to keep reading. (More a comment for part 1, but noticed it here.)

EDIT: Also, the quote box story is working for me now.

"Little is known of the Vae Lynx, for he is an Eye of Historia, a title given not to one but to many. Theirs is the realm of story and lore, of fantasy and reality. They write what is, what was, and what could be, but hold no power to change any of it. The Eyes of Historia are scarcely mentioned in the books of the Daeva, but it is speculated that the books themselves were written by Eyes. Of what is known of the Eyes are names such as the Vae Lynx, Drow Ursine, D'mat IX, Azail In-Flux, and Djoric the All-Seeing."

…yeah, this is why I don't write for this canon.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
• Bees - A greater god, that is, one that exists outside of the universe rather than within it, and one of the more powerful greater gods at that. We're talking roughly on the same tier as the Scarlet King here. Known but not worshiped by the Daevas, for obvious reasons. The oracle who first discovered the Bees had this to say:

"I have looked into the deepest hell. Hell was bees."

  • Chowderclef - Lesser god, roughly on the same level as Wondertainment, some relation between the two is suspected. No connection to the supposed Foundation employee of the same name, who as far as I'm concerned does not exist in this universe.

Done and done.
